umf: 0.10.0
id: unified-commerce
title: Unified client commerce fixture
vocabularies:
  umf.actions:
    version: 0.1.0
modules:
  - id: commerce
    namespace: example.commerce
    elements:
      - id: customerId
        name: customerId
        kind: field
        scalarType: string
        cardinality: one
        nullability: required
        extensions: {}
      - id: customerUuid
        name: customerUuid
        kind: field
        scalarType: uuid
        cardinality: one
        nullability: required
        extensions: {}
      - id: externalId
        name: externalId
        kind: field
        scalarType: bits128
        cardinality: one
        nullability: required
        extensions: {}
      - id: customerName
        name: customerName
        kind: field
        scalarType: string
        cardinality: one
        nullability: required
        extensions: {}
      - id: orderId
        name: orderId
        kind: field
        scalarType: string
        cardinality: one
        nullability: required
        extensions: {}
      - id: orderCustomerId
        name: orderCustomerId
        kind: field
        scalarType: string
        cardinality: one
        nullability: required
        extensions: {}
      - id: status
        name: status
        kind: field
        scalarType: string
        cardinality: one
        nullability: required
        extensions: {}
      - id: amount
        name: amount
        kind: field
        scalarType: decimal
        cardinality: one
        nullability: required
        facets:
          precision: 8
          scale: 2
        extensions: {}
      - id: Customer
        name: Customer
        kind: record
        members:
          - module: commerce
            element: customerId
          - module: commerce
            element: customerUuid
          - module: commerce
            element: externalId
          - module: commerce
            element: customerName
        keys:
          - id: primary
            name: primary
            primary: true
            fields:
              - module: commerce
                element: customerId
        extensions: {}
      - id: Order
        name: Order
        kind: record
        members:
          - module: commerce
            element: orderId
          - module: commerce
            element: orderCustomerId
          - module: commerce
            element: status
          - module: commerce
            element: amount
        keys:
          - id: primary
            name: primary
            primary: true
            fields:
              - module: commerce
                element: orderId
        extensions: {}
    relationships:
      - id: orderCustomer
        name: customer
        source:
          - module: commerce
            element: Order
        target:
          - module: commerce
            element: Customer
            key: primary
        sourceMultiplicity:
          min: 0
          max: "*"
        targetMultiplicity:
          min: 1
          max: 1
        targetLifecycle: independent
        directed: true
        inverse: orders
    extensions:
      umf.actions:
        actions:
          - id: shipOrder
            name: Ship order
            description: Set an order status to shipped.
            parameters:
              - id: entityOrder
                name: order
                kind: entity
                target:
                  module: commerce
                  element: Order
                  key: primary
                required: true
            outputs: []
            preconditions: []
            postconditions: []
            failures: []
            reads: []
            writes:
              - id: orderWrite
                record:
                  module: commerce
                  element: Order
                selector:
                  language: umf.actions.keys
                  version: "1"
                  expression: '{"entity":"entityOrder"}'
                  references:
                    - parameter: entityOrder
                maxEntities: 1
                fields:
                  - module: commerce
                    element: status
                relationships: []
                create: false
                delete: false
            binding:
              kind: recipe
              profile:
                id: graph-write
                version: "1"
              effects:
                - id: setShipped
                  kind: set
                  entity:
                    parameter: entityOrder
                  values:
                    - field:
                        module: commerce
                        element: status
                      value:
                        literal:
                          string: shipped
            authorization:
              kind: roles
              profile:
                id: umf.actions.roles
                version: "1"
              roles:
                - shipper
            attribution:
              subject: person-required
            atomicity: single-store
            idempotency: caller-key-optional
            result:
              identities: created-and-changed
              version: store-opaque
              receipt: read-at-least
